                          Auto Share

                          Open a Whatnot live show in the active tab.

                          Sharing opens this show in a muted background tab next to yours and keeps clicking there, so your tab is never touched. A share counts only after Whatnot records it. Closing that tab stops sharing. Shortcut: Alt+Shift+S starts or stops sharing on the active show.

                          Shares today

                          No hourly, daily, or per-show caps. Sharing still pauses if Whatnot shows a warning.

                          Button locations

                          If sharing can't find Whatnot's buttons, show them once: click Pick, then click the Share button on the show, then the share option (Copy link, X, or Facebook). Press Esc after the Share button if it shares in one click.

                                          Your Whatnot account

                                          Appraisal (coins, cards, vintage, and more)

                                          Checked: appraisals go straight to this server. Cloud AI and Chrome's on-device model are not called. Unchecked: Ollama starts only after the preferred cloud AI has had 5 seconds. The model has to accept images.

                                          Shortcut: Alt+Shift+V appraises the item on the active show.

                                          Selector overrides

                                          If a Whatnot redesign breaks detection, patch it here without a new build. Keys: followButton, showCard, bookmarkButton, shareButton, shareTargets {copy, x, facebook}, bidButton, warningPattern. A hosted URL must allow CORS (GitHub raw or gist works).

                                          Diagnose this tab

                                          Shows what the extension detects on the active Whatnot page. Use it before a real run, and after Whatnot changes its site.
